M-0083_A-0054-14-0D63.reason: `Switching times in the device` = 1 selects a <choose> that splits the 0x47E4 AbsSegment into three; the System 7 path allocates the branch's 899 octets but streams the whole 5406-octet code segment, knx-sim rejects the writes past 0x4B67 and the flash runs into the command timeout; System 7 twin of #411 (#407 sim run)
